subject: Publishing ggvis graphics on the web

messages.author: 82ba4ef6c5e730d7
messages.subject: Publishing ggvis graphics on the web
parts:
What is the preferred way for publishing ggvis graphics on the web? 

To keep them in tact a la the examples on ggvis.rstudio.com, I had to copy the javascript lib directory and paste in the proper subset of the automatically generated html. Is this the recommended method?

messages.author: ce0aa274fe827fda
messages.subject: Re: Publishing ggvis graphics on the web
parts:
Depending on what your goal is, you could create a simple .Rmd document with your ggvis graphics and some scaffolding text (or CSS, for that matter), and publish it via https://shinyapps.io, which seems to work quite alright so far, even if it's in its early days as of now.

At least that's the most straightforward(ish) way I can think of without having to worry about javascript dependencies yourself.

Regards,
Jemus42
